physicalActsNoPacketCanPerform.label: Fingerprint box — LEFT INDEX FINGER
physicalActsNoPacketCanPerform.why: this box takes an inked rolled fingerprint impression, which page 1 of the form calls mandatory. Nothing a packet can draw belongs in it.
